Eastern Front Music Pack Paradox Steam Released on 2021-06-03. Ever since Spartans marched to war with pipers by their side, music has been an essential part of military order and morale. Fight the greatest armed struggle of the 20th century with 13 new song tracks for four nations battling on the Eastern Front. 4 New Soviet Songs: White Army, Black Baron Volkhov Drinking Song Dark is the Night The National Anthem of the USSR. 3 New Romanian Songs: Treceti Batalioane, Pui de lei, Drum Bun. 4 New German Songs: Lili Marlene, Die Wacht am Rhein, Alte Kameraden, Wir fahren gegen Engeland. 2 New Polish Songs: Pierwsza Pancerna My, Pierwsza Brygada.

Bonus Songs Pack Paradox Steam Released on 2025-05-15. Round out the musical landscape of your war plans and industrial buildup with this pack of six songs originally only available through pre-orders. This collection of music inspired by the World War II setting includes period anthems and original arrangements of classic tunes. March of the Eagles: A pre-order bonus for the espionage focused expansion La Resistance, this stirring march has elements of French classical compositions and European chorale. Katyusha: A pre-order bonus for the Soviet Union themed expansion No Step Back, this is an original arrangement of a Soviet wartime hymn to the patriotic sacrifices made on the eastern front. Bella Ciao: A pre-order bonus for the Italian focused expansion By Blood Alone, “Bella Ciao” became a popular Italian anti-Fascist anthem during the war years. Säkkijärven Polkka: A pre-order bonus for the Nordic themed expansion Arms Against Tyranny, this Finnish folk song became popular on the frontlines of the Winter War, with its chords used as a means of disrupting Soviet radio mines. Carnaval Do Brasil: A pre-order bonus for the South American themed expansion Trial of Allegiance, this is a pastiche of military brass and traditional Brazilian party melodies. Ride of the Valkyries: A pre-order bonus for the German and Central European themed expansion Götterdämmerung, this familiar excerpt from Wagner’s Ring Cycle opera Die Walküre has become synonymous with the threat of war.

Axis Armor Pack Paradox Steam Released on 2019-06-04. Axis Armor Units: Adds 53 armor models for fascist regimes: Germany: 19 models from a range of tank destroyers, self propelled artillery and self propelled anti-air vehicles, including the Stug III, the Wespe and the Elefant heavy tank destroyer. Italy: 12 models from a roster of Semovente tank destroyers and the always outmatched L6 tank highlight this list of Italian armor from the war. Japan: 22 models from a range of every armor type, with seven different Japanese tank designs like the experimental heavy O-I tank that never went into production and a number of tank destroyers. Axis Tank Units: Adds 8 tank units to Germany, including the King Tiger and the Maus super heavy tank.
